title: Phase 1: daemon startAndonServices spawns agent-agnostic runtime-writer
description: Wire scripts/andon-runtime-writer.mjs into src/daemon.ts startAndonServices(), spawned like the API (HOLISTIC_REPO=rootDir), tracked in owned[] and killed via killTree on shutdown. Fixes 'agent disconnected' for ALL agents since the writer forwards state.json heartbeats agnostically.

title: Generate .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, .github/copilot-instructions.md on bootstrap
description: Complete adapter file matrix on bootstrap. Currently generates CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md — missing .cursorrules (Cursor), .windsurfrules (Windsurf), .github/copilot-instructions.md (GitHub Copilot).
notes:
## Implementation slices

**Files:** src/core/docs.ts (writeDerivedDocs, renderAdapter, renderRootAgentDoc)

### Slice 1 — Add renderCursorRules() template
- Similar to renderRootAgentDoc() but formatted for .cursorrules syntax
- Include: project context summary, do-not-break list, handoff instruction, MCP tool hint
- Output path: .cursorrules (repo root)

### Slice 2 — Add renderWindsurfRules() template
- Same content shape as .cursorrules, output to .windsurfrules (repo root)

### Slice 3 — Add renderCopilotInstructions() template
- Output to .github/copilot-instructions.md
- Create .github/ dir if not present (mkdir -p equivalent)

### Slice 4 — Wire all three into writeDerivedDocs()
- Add calls after existing CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md generation (lines 685-688 in docs.ts)
- Add to DocIndex mapping in state.ts so they get tracked

### Slice 5 — Bootstrap commit guidance update
- Update README bootstrap instructions to mention committing the new files
- Update .gitattributes template to include the three new paths

### Slice 6 — Smoke test
- bootstrap a test repo, verify all three files exist with populated content

title: Clarify Antigravity startup behavior and integration path
description: Holistic currently documents the desired Antigravity startup contract, but one-time repo initialization does not itself guarantee that Antigravity IDE will ask the user what to do on repo open. Preserve this gap as follow-up work so the next session can either tighten the docs or implement a real Antigravity startup integration if one exists.
acceptance_criteria: Docs no longer imply one-time init alone guarantees Antigravity auto-resume; or a real Antigravity startup hook/workspace automation is identified and integrated.

title: Andon service auto-start (API + dashboard) on repo open
description: When a developer opens the Holistic repo, the Andon API (port 4318) and dashboard dev server (port 5173) should start automatically in the background. Currently requires manual startup. Auto-start should be idempotent (skip if already running). Wired via Claude Code SessionStart hook calling .holistic-local/system/start-andon.ps1.

title: Cursor integration
description: Generate cursor-specific adapter files on bootstrap. Blocked by / should be done alongside holistic-7i6 (full adapter matrix: .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, .github/copilot-instructions.md). Cursor is already in the agent enum but cursor-specific file generation is absent.

title: Test: killTree terminates Andon child processes on daemon shutdown
description: Integration test verifying that when the daemon stops (SIGTERM/SIGINT), killTree is called on Andon child processes and those processes are actually dead afterward. On Windows this means taskkill /t /f cleans the full process tree including vite grandchildren. Requires spawning real child processes in the test.

title: Phase 2: runtime-writer emits agent-agnostic running/waiting/needs_input from state.json
description: Enhance scripts/andon-runtime-writer.mjs to translate state.json latestStatus/completionSignal into session.needs_input (waiting) vs running, agent-agnostically. Replaces the Claude-only session.needs_input Stop-hook hack.

title: Expand AgentName union and adapter routing
Bake holistic_handoff call into every adapter file as explicit session-end instruction
description: Every adapter file should include an explicit end-of-session instruction: 'before ending this conversation, call holistic_handoff'. Currently a separate user habit, not baked in. Write-back reliability for non-hook paths depends on this.
notes:
## Implementation slices

**Files:** src/core/docs.ts (renderAdapter, renderRootAgentDoc, renderAgentsMd, renderHolisticMd)

### Slice 1 — Define standard session-close block
- Write a shared renderSessionCloseBlock(hasMcp: boolean) helper
- MCP-capable agents: 'Before ending this session, call holistic_handoff with a summary of what you did and what should happen next.'
- Non-MCP agents (Codex, Cursor, etc.): 'Before ending this session, run: holistic handoff --summary "..." --next "..."'

### Slice 2 — Inject into renderAdapter() 
- Add session-close block to the bottom of every adapter doc (docs.ts lines 427-470)
- Applies to: codex.md, claude-cowork.md, antigravity.md and the new cursorrules/windsurf/copilot files from holistic-7i6

### Slice 3 — Inject into renderRootAgentDoc()
- CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md should also carry the instruction

### Slice 4 — Inject into renderAgentsMd() / renderHolisticMd()
- AGENTS.md contributor workflow section should include it
- HOLISTIC.md contributor workflow section should include it

### Slice 5 — Verify no duplication on re-runs
- writeDerivedDocs() regenerates from templates — no state tracking needed, just ensure template always includes it

title: Test: startAndonServices spawns API and dashboard on free ports
description: Unit/integration test verifying that startAndonServices spawns the Andon API process when port 4318 is free and the dashboard process when port 5173 is free, and skips both when ports are already occupied. Requires process lifecycle management in the test (spawn + kill). See daemon.ts startAndonServices().

title: MCP server mode (holistic serve)
description: Implement holistic serve MCP server mode. Also address MCP notification reliability: sending context as a logging message at connect time is fragile — most clients don't surface log-level messages to the model. The right injection path for Claude Code is the SessionStart hook (holistic-q3f). For non-Claude-Code MCP clients, ensure tool description says 'Call this FIRST at conversation start' as explicit fallback.

title: Claude Code SessionStart hook — auto-inject context on session open
description: Install a Claude Code SessionStart hook during bootstrap. Fires before the first user message — guaranteed context injection, no prompt discipline required.
notes:
## Implementation slices

**Files:** src/core/setup.ts (new installer fn), src/core/git-hooks.ts (reference pattern)

### Slice 1 — Detect Claude Code environment
- Check for .claude/ dir in repo root during bootstrap
- Add claudeCodePresent flag to bootstrap plan

### Slice 2 — Write installClaudeCodeHooks() in setup.ts
- Generate .claude/settings.json (or merge if exists) with hooks block:
  { "hooks": { "SessionStart": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "<holistic-cmd> resume --agent claude-code" }] }] } }
- Use HOLISTIC-MANAGED marker in a comment so future refreshes can update it
- Platform-aware: use .holistic/system/holistic.cmd on Windows, .holistic/system/holistic on Unix

### Slice 3 — Wire into bootstrapHolistic() in setup.ts
- After existing git hook install step, call installClaudeCodeHooks()
- Print install confirmation in bootstrap output

### Slice 4 — Add refreshClaudeCodeHooks() for re-runs
- bootstrap is idempotent; re-running should update the hook command without duplicating
- Merge strategy: if HOLISTIC-MANAGED section exists, replace it; else append

### Slice 5 — Smoke test
- bootstrap a test repo, verify .claude/settings.json exists with correct hook
- Verify hook fires on session open (manual verify)

title: Retire Claude-only andon-hook.ps1/.sh + setup.ts installer
description: Remove the Claude-only PostToolUse/Stop andon-hook scripts and their setup.ts installer (installAndonHooks/refreshAndonHooks/render*) once the agent-agnostic writer covers liveness+turn-state. Eliminates recurring worktree breakage and the agent-agnostic principle violation.

title: Fix stuck Fleet objective and parked status drift in Andon live board
description: Mission Control repeatedly shows the same stale card as active context: "cursor · Parked · Implementing M007: Event Forwarding (Daemon & Wrappers)" even after new work, restarts, and refresh. Live board behavior is still being influenced by stale legacy/session narrative events or stale activeSession carryover instead of authoritative runtime truth. This erodes operator trust in Andon's real-time supervision role.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Fleet live status/objective comes from runtime harness truth (runtime_sessions + runtime_processes + runtime_events) only. 2) A stale legacy objective cannot remain pinned after runtime status changes. 3) "needs_input" and "flowing" states require current runtime evidence (waiting/running + fresh heartbeat), not historical question/resume markers. 4) If runtime feed is unavailable, board shows explicit disconnected/degraded runtime state instead of stale inferred activity. 5) Regression tests cover the stuck-objective scenario and prevent recurrence.

title: Verify and fix auto-sync: state ref must push automatically, not just queue
description: Verify and fix the auto-sync path end-to-end. requestAutoSync() spawns a detached process calling sync-state.ps1/sh, which does git push refs/holistic/state. If the script is missing, auto-sync silently does nothing. Pre-push hook shows instructions instead of syncing.
notes:
## Implementation slices

**Files:** src/core/sync.ts, src/core/setup.ts (script generation), src/core/git-hooks.ts (pre-push hook)

### Slice 1 — Audit sync-state script generation
- Verify sync-state.ps1 and sync-state.sh are always written during bootstrap (setup.ts lines 365-482)
- Check the git push command: 'git -c core.hooksPath=NUL push $remote HEAD:$stateRef'
- Verify remote and stateRef are interpolated correctly at generation time vs. runtime
- Check: what happens when remote is not configured? Should fail gracefully with a log message, not silently

### Slice 2 — Add sync verification to holistic status
- holistic status should report: last sync time, whether state ref exists on remote, whether scripts exist
- Makes the silent failure visible

### Slice 3 — Fix the pre-push hook
- Current pre-push just shows a status reminder (git-hooks.ts lines 91-107)
- Change it to actually call sync-state script before push
- This ensures state is always pushed when code is pushed

### Slice 4 — Add requestAutoSync() error surface
- Detached process errors are currently swallowed (stdio: 'ignore')
- Write stderr to a .holistic/system/sync.log so failures are diagnosable
- holistic status can show last sync error if present

### Slice 5 — End-to-end test
- checkpoint → verify script runs → verify refs/holistic/state exists on remote
- Test on both Windows (ps1) and Unix (sh)

title: Andon agent-agnostic forwarding (epic): daemon-driven runtime-writer replaces Claude-only hooks
Claude Code UserPromptSubmit hook — periodic write-back for uncommitted work
description: Install a Claude Code UserPromptSubmit hook that periodically snapshots state for non-commit work. Closes the write-back dead zone: planning, research, architectural decisions that never produce a commit currently vanish.
notes:
## Implementation slices

**Files:** src/core/setup.ts (extend installClaudeCodeHooks from holistic-q3f)

**Dependency:** holistic-q3f must land first (establishes .claude/settings.json merge pattern)

### Slice 1 — Design the debounce strategy
- UserPromptSubmit fires on every prompt — calling checkpoint every time is too noisy
- Approach: write a lightweight wrapper script that checks last-checkpoint timestamp, only checkpoints if >15 min elapsed
- Store last-auto-checkpoint time in .holistic/state.json

### Slice 2 — Add addLastAutoCheckpoint field to HolisticState (types.ts)
- lastAutoCheckpoint: ISO timestamp string | undefined

### Slice 3 — Write the debounce shell script (generated in .holistic/system/)
- check-and-checkpoint.sh / check-and-checkpoint.ps1
- Reads lastAutoCheckpoint from state.json, compares to now, calls holistic checkpoint if threshold exceeded
- Reason string: 'auto periodic snapshot'

### Slice 4 — Extend installClaudeCodeHooks() to add UserPromptSubmit entry
- Add to .claude/settings.json hooks block alongside SessionStart
- Command: call check-and-checkpoint script

### Slice 5 — Smoke test
- Verify hook fires, respects debounce, and only checkpoints when threshold exceeded

title: Phase 3: data-driven per-agent turn-signal adapters + worktree propagation
description: Per-agent turn hooks (Claude Stop, Gemini AfterTool, etc.) declared in .holistic-local/context/adapters/<agent>.md (data, not source). Installer reads adapter and applies hook config to the correct per-agent location, propagated to active worktrees.
